audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads EVEN at 5.5/10 while the Emerald+ win rate is 57.75% over 1020 games.
audit.why: A 57.75% win rate is a favourable lane, not an even one. Left the enum alone and flagged it rather than guessing the site's rating direction.
audit.corrected: Lane difficulty: favourable for Akshan through levels 1-6; Mel only takes over once Golden Eclipse and Overwhelm scaling land.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] carry the wrong stage labels (both read Levels 4-5 / Level 6 against rows that are Level 6 and First item).
audit.why: Row 4 is Level 6 and row 5 is First item. The spike text was describing the wrong stage.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Comeuppance at 2500 range; First item = swing-autos shred; 2+ items = Golden Eclipse global scaling flips it to Mel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel's W is repeatedly called 'Rebuke' and her passive 'Twin Disciplines' — both are fabricated. Rebuttal's damage immunity is never stated, and Solar Snare / Golden Eclipse / Overwhelm are never named.
audit.why: Rebuttal (W) reflects projectiles AND prevents her taking damage — that matters because Akshan's Q, passive extra shot and Comeuppance bullets are all projectiles. Solar Snare (E) roots and Akshan has no dash to break it. Golden Eclipse (R) hits every Overwhelm-marked target regardless of distance.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal (W, 38/35/33/29/26s) reflects your Q, your passive's extra shot and Comeuppance's bullets, and blocks all damage for its duration — poke only in its downtime. Solar Snare (E, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) roots at the orb's centre; Heroic Swing cannot be used to escape once you are rooted, so pre-empt it. Overwhelm stacks execute on a threshold, so track the HP number rather than the bar.

audit.why: Rebuttal at 38s rank 1 is the single most punishable cooldown in the lane.
audit.corrected: Fight in the 38-second window after Rebuttal ends.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flagged whys[2] 'Heroic Swing' as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is Akshan's real E name. False positive in suspectNames.
audit.corrected: No change needed to that name.

edits.after: Mel's Radiant Volley and Solar Snare want you standing inside zones, but Heroic Swing at 15s rank 3 pulls you off both and resets the trade before her Overwhelm stacks matter.

edits.before: Her Rebuke reflect punishes hard-committed dashes, so time your Comeuppance engage around her cooldown rather than into a raised shield, or you eat the counter instead of landing the kill.

edits.before: Once she's stacked AP and picked up her core items, Mel's reflect-and-poke kit starts to out-scale your flat damage, and a caught Comeuppance into her Rebuke can flip the fight in her favor.
edits.after: Once she has core AP, Golden Eclipse strikes every Overwhelm-marked target from anywhere on an 80s rank-3 cooldown, so a Comeuppance fired into a raised Rebuttal flips the fight to her.

edits.after: Levels 3 through 6 stay yours as long as you respect Rebuttal's 38s reflect — bait it with a Q, then engage, since the raised barrier also blocks all damage for the whole of its duration.
